svg.title: PowerCut — 1,908 Wh plan against a 1,800 Wh budget
svg.desc: Real PowerCut Vega Virtual Device screenshot: six synthetic appliance estimates need 1,908 Wh against a 1,800 Wh battery, 108 Wh over. Pipeline: on-device TypeScript solver, independent schedule verifier, Python reference; 231 differential scenarios.
svg.text: A constraint solver you operate with a TV remote.
